evidence_items.finding: average debtor days of 68 against 30-day payment terms — receivables running at more than double the agreed collection period
evidence_items.rationale: 68-day average collection on 30-day terms is a critical adverse working capital signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: primary demand channel (trade show calendar) is delivering approximately half the lead volume of twelve months ago
evidence_items.rationale: Primary channel delivering half the lead volume is a critical adverse demand generation signal. market_position; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the business has no alternative demand channel and all new client relationships originate from trade shows
evidence_items.rationale: Single channel dependency with declining channel performance is a critical adverse market position signal. market_position; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the owner is requesting a credit facility to address cash pressure without having analysed whether the cash pressure is from collection lag or pipeline decline
evidence_items.rationale: Credit facility request without diagnosis of whether the cash issue is structural or timing is an adverse evidence signal. financial_health.

evidence_items.finding: B2B office supplies; AR at 68 days vs 30-day terms; trade show leads at 50% of prior volume; credit facility request; no alternative demand channel
Surface signal (not root cause): the AR collection lag and the reduced lead volume together create a cash shortfall that appears to be a single working capital problem solvable with a credit line
evidence_items.rationale: The surface appearance of a single working capital problem is a misleading signal — these are two independent structural failures with different causes and different interventions.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the business has historically been profitable and has never required external financing before
evidence_items.rationale: Historical profitability and no prior debt is a misleading stability signal — it does not mean a credit facility is the correct intervention when the cash shortfall has two independent structural causes.
